title: CoreStopSummary
description: What the shared Rust core returns to the Logger when a test stops (RustCore.stopTest / pollStatus over JNI; core/src/ue.rs FlowSummary): per-flow counters. dropped_rows > 0 means the flow's log ring overflowed — the core also writes an ERROR event (contracts/internal/logger_sink.md) and the Logger uploads the test as PARTIAL.

dropped_rows.description: Packet rows lost to ring overflow (not packets lost on the network).
